run_segmentation_inference: run semantic segmentation inference on a single image using an MMSegInferencer model config and checkpoint
build_inferencer_from_config: build an MMSegInferencer model from a config file and optional checkpoint for segmentation tasks
test_single_image: test a single image through the segmentation model and save results to an output directory
display_segmentation_result: display the segmentation result overlay on the original image with configurable opacity
configure_inference_device: configure the inference device such as cuda or cpu for running segmentation on the model
